headline: Sensex Gains 299 Points as Metals and Financials Drive Rebound; Nifty Crosses 23,400

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Rebound in metal, realty, and financial stocks drove the benchmark indices to 2-week highs.
OECD upgraded India's growth projection for FY 2026-27 to 7.1%.
Easing crude oil prices provided relief to broader market sentiment.
Positive global cues and strong domestic investor interest supported market momentum.
whatHappening: Sensex ended 299 points higher, while Nifty 50 closed above the 23,400 mark.
Whirlpool of India stock surged 20% to hit the upper circuit amid promoter stake sale buzz.
Ola Electric Mobility rallied 11%, while Bajaj Finance and Hindalco emerged among top gainers.
ICRA reported that oil marketing companies face daily fuel losses of ₹530 crore due to high crude prices.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices rebounded sharply, with Sensex gaining 299 points and Nifty closing above 23,400.
Economic confidence was bolstered as OECD upgraded India's FY27 growth forecast to 7.1%.
Metal and financial stocks led the rally, while Whirlpool of India and Ola Electric posted double-digit gains.
